name: Speak-No-Evil Monkey
baseMeaning: A monkey covering its mouth with its hands.
tldr: 'Oops I said too much' or keeping a secret. The 'shouldn't have said that' emoji.

Implying you have gossip or a secret.
Pretending to keep quiet about something obvious.

seoTitle: 🙊 Speak-No-Evil Monkey Meaning - What Does 🙊 Really Mean?
seoDescription: Learn what the speak-no-evil monkey emoji 🙊 really means in modern texting. The 'oops I said too much' emoji. Complete context guide.

longForm.overview:
The 🙊 Speak-No-Evil Monkey emoji was added in Unicode 6 (2010) and is drawn as a brown monkey face with both hands covering its mouth, an expression of silent discretion. The visual cue reads instantly as shush-coded monkey, secret-keeping-coded default, or the visible 'I am not telling' tag. By 2026 🙊 has become the go-to emoji for the speak-no-evil reaction, the visible shush default, and the secret-keeping-coded reaction in close-friends and family chats.

In modern chat 🙊 does very specific work. People send it as a literal monkey reference, as the visible 'my lips are sealed' tag, or as the gossip-coded default. The hands covering the mouth are the visual cue that the read is speak-no-evil-coded. Writers should pick 🙊 when the read is keeping a secret or visible 'I am not telling' energy, and avoid it when the read is full monkey — 🙈 fits better there.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
🙊 lands on a friend's 'I won't say a word' message, in a work channel where someone is signaling secret-keeping energy, and in a dating-app DM where the sender is signaling 'I am keeping this between us'. The hands covering the mouth anchor the read.

In close-friends chats 🙊 reads as the universal speak-no-evil default and the visible 'my lips are sealed' tag. On X the emoji punctuates gossip-coded and secret-keeping tweets. The emoji pairs with 🙈 for the layered monkey-trio stack and with 🤐 for the layered shush-monkey pair stack.
longForm.whenNotToUse: Skip 🙊 in any context where the read is full-mono reaction. The hands-over-mouth imply speak-no-evil-coded, not general-monkey. Avoid 🙊 in formal contexts where the secret-keeping-coded read lands as unprofessional.
longForm.howToReply:
If a friend sends 🙊 on a secret-coded message, mirror with another 🙊 or 🤐 to match the energy. The shush chain reads as solidarity.

If 🙊 lands as the gossip-coded default, reply with another 🙊 or 🙈. And if you want to send 🙊 yourself, pair it with the moment so the speak-no-evil-coded read is clear.

faqs.question: What does 🙊 mean in text?
faqs.answer: 🙊 means speak-no-evil-coded reference, visible 'my lips are sealed' energy, or the secret-keeping reaction. The hands covering the mouth are the visual cue that the read is speak-no-evil-coded.

faqs.question: Is 🙊 flirty?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. 🙊 reads as flirty-coded in a dating thread combined with 'this is just between us' content.

faqs.question: What does 🙊 mean from a girl?
faqs.answer: From a girl or anyone, 🙊 carries the same speak-no-evil-coded read. There is no gendered meaning; the emoji works the same regardless.

faqs.question: What does 🙊 mean on Instagram?
faqs.answer: On Instagram, 🙊 is the default sticker on gossip-coded captions and secret-keeping-coded story overlays.
